name: openphotex
description: Reference implementation of Terminal Reality game data formats (MTM, CPR, TV, Fury3, Hellbender, 4x4 Evolution, Fly!, Nocturne), for browsers, Node.js and command-line/agent use.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.cli.json && chmod +x dist/cli/main.js
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.cli.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
